contacts.name: Maya Chen
contacts.overrideBody: I photograph performing arts in New York and saw you're self-presenting Midnight Quartet at Weill Recital Hall on August 15. I shoot unobtrusive, no-flash documentary coverage and think it would suit your program. My rate is $250 an hour plus tax, one-hour minimum, with the gallery delivered within two weeks. Recent work is at danwrightphotography.com/music. Let me know how that lands.
